description: Batch A validation plan, separate from the accepted core plan (validation_plan.json). Every reference listed here is required: an absent, undeclared or incomplete reference FAILS. References are column selections from the authoritative frozen V1.4 outputs; no new-package output is used as a reference. Tolerances are the existing named set 'cumulative' (exact 1e-12; within 1e-7 + 1e-6 relative).

references.name: batchA_diagnostics
references.scope: Batch A: 16 influence/design diagnostic columns of the 1,680 cumulative specifications

references.name: batchA_bivariate
references.scope: Batch A: 240 cumulative bivariate tests (Pearson / point-biserial, Spearman, descriptive q families)

references.name: batchA_table1
references.scope: Batch A: cohort table (17 rows) of the original descriptive analysis

references.name: batchA_group_summaries
references.scope: Batch A: outcome summaries by age group, sex, ethnicity and locality (30 rows)

references.name: batchA_group_tests
references.scope: Batch A: group tests with BH within outcome (12 rows)
